findings.summary: Mechanical product-tree equivalence between work_head_commit 24c587bb7440bf2d634aafec38651c158bca0459 and subject_commit eda0805ba30b32ba545ac65f41b4849dc5dcccd7 (excluding .dev-dispatch) could not be established with available file-inspection tools; no shell or Git command was executed and no product-tree mismatch is asserted. The current commit's changes all live in the reserved .dev-dispatch namespace (implement handoff metadata). Actual Git HEAD verification remains the deterministic seal's responsibility.

Goal version activation (activate_version) and the live Goal ReAct port remain unwired into the production composition path (build_line constructs GoalRequestKernel with an empty active_version and an unbound goal_call). Explicit-version/stale-version-refusal and unsupported-capability (goal_call_unwired) semantics are fully implemented and offline-tested; live binding is deferred per approved.md 'Deferred verification and later slices'. Not a development-stage violation.

Live Runtime, integration, deployment and joint E2E scenarios were not run. They remain deferred under the development-stage constraints of this experiment and are not grounds for this verdict; this review does not establish production acceptance or whole-Goal ready_for_joint_validation.
